text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This very evening, a terrifying<n>monster will descend
upon you...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: OoOoOh, And now, to curse yoOuUu<n>toOoOo!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaand cut! That rehearsal was<n>perfect! Boy, am I
glad I asked you to<n>play this part!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! I'll do my best<n>to help
promote the park's<n>"Heart-Pounding ☆ Horror
Night"<n>event.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, the amusement park is<n>shooting an event
commercial, and<n>Super Creek is playing one of the
monsters that attack the park<n>guests...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...So how come me and your trainer<n>gotta be
extras? We just came to<n>watch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eh, I guess this is Creek's big break.Sure, I'll do what I can!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both very much. Let's all<n>work together
to make this the best<n>commercial it can be! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Right, next is the scene where the<n>extras make a
frantic escape! And<n>four... three... two... Action!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrraaawwwr!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Grughhhnnnn... Ughhh....

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Now, join me... in eternal slumbeeer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eep! I can't believe they're not real!<n>I'm gettin' da
heebie-jeebies!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Nghhhh... Uwaghhhh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! Is Tamtam all right?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Next up we've got the forest scene!<n>This is where
the wolfman takes a<n>great big bite out of our
academy<n>trainer!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrrawwrrrr! Gahhh!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I... I...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't take this any longer! Mr.<n>Werewolf, please,
leave them alone!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrr... Rawr?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya doin'?! You're supposed<n>to be a crazy
mummy!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh no, you've got it wrong. I'm amommy, not a mummy! Were youafraid? Are you hurt? I can wrap youright up with one of my bandages. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! I'm not scared, I'm actin'!<n>Plus, it's not like
I've been bitten or<n>anythin' either!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't you fret. Just leave it to<n>Mommy! I've got a
bundle of cuddles<n>with your name written all over it.
♪

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: G-grrrr... Grawwwr!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear. Well, if you're not going to<n>behave, then
I'll have to cast a "good<n>boy" curse on you!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: ...Cut! Cut, cut, cuuuut!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Ah! I'm so sorry! I completely<n>forgot we were
filming and—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: That.... was... INCREDIBLE!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How come? Wasn't Creek<n>way outta line
with her improv?!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely not! This'll be an<n>emotion-packed
masterpiece about a<n>mummy who awakens to her
maternal instincts! What an<n>astonishing
performance! This<n>commercial's gonna go viral for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, will it? I just couldn't bear to<n>leave the two of
them so helpless...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely your realism that made<n>it so effective!
You think so too, don't<n>you, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
You wouldn't get a performance like that from
anyone else!
I'm not sure this'll work as an ad for the event...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well, I'm relieved to hear<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's keep up this momentum!<n>Okay, we're
gonna pick up from<n>when our mummy awakens to
her<n>maternal instincts!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, um... should I go like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, you're such a good girl.<n>There, there...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're not even actin' anymore!<n>You're scarier
than the actual<n>monsters!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The commercial, which ends up being<n>a showcase
of motherly love, goes<n>viral a few days later. I hear
the event<n>itself turns out to be a massive<n>success
from day one!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, you're totally right! I'm sorry<n>for going off
and doing my own thing.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: True, I do want to capture a normaltake, actually! ...Let's go from thescene with the wolfman attack!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrrahhh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: AAAH! SOMEONE HELP ME!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I-I just can't! Pleeease don't hurt<n>them!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Countless retakes later, the cast and<n>crew
eventually manage to wrap up<n>the shoot!
